title: 共和党众议员劳勒：党内使命统一，核心议题是生活成本
speaker: Mike Lawler

segments.en: We'll see what happens on Tuesday, for instance, in Kentucky with Thomas Massey and Ed Garene. We spoke with Joe Grooters a few a few days ago, the chair of the RNC and talked a bit about the party strategy going into these primaries. Let's play a little bit of what he had to say and I'll ask about it on the other side.
segments.zh: 周二肯塔基州的初选结果如何，我们拭目以待。几天前我们采访了共和党全国委员会主席，谈到了初选策略。

segments.en: We're going to win by embracing the president and bracing this administration and making sure their candidates are in lockstep with the mission that he's trying to push forward. Let me ask you, Carson, just about that, the mission that he's trying to push forward that the president is trying to push forward and how unified is that sense of mission going forward.
segments.zh: 我们将通过拥抱总统、支持政府，确保候选人与总统推进的使命保持一致。请问，这种使命感的统一程度如何？

segments.en: Here we talk a lot about the conflict in the Middle East, the effect that's having on prices here back home, concerned about energy prices, etc. As Christina brought up here in this unique district where I think you're facing a lot of competition for your seat. And it's a unique district in many ways. How unified is that mission, that sense of mission when Republicans were running for election this year?
segments.zh: 我们谈论中东冲突对国内价格的影响，能源价格等。在这个独特的选区，您面临激烈竞争。今年共和党竞选时，这种使命感的统一程度如何？

segments.en: Well, first of all, we have all run on and won on previously the issue of affordability.
segments.zh: 首先，我们过去竞选和获胜都基于生活成本议题。
